jobs.title: Technology Coordinator
jobs.scope_summary: Runs the district's instructional technology, with an AI and innovation remit to support safe staff and student use of AI tools and to evaluate new classroom technology.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Specialist
jobs.scope_summary: Staff role in the university's new Department of AI and Educational Technology, supporting AI solutions for teaching, research and campus operations.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer and AI Learning Specialist
jobs.scope_summary: Builds and revises online courses in Canvas, and leads how AI gets used in course design. Writes the prompts, templates and AI-supported workflows the design team runs on, and keeps the work inside the university's AI and academic integrity policies.

jobs.title: Learning Technologist and AI Coordinator
jobs.scope_summary: Runs Canvas and instructional technology support, and coordinates how generative AI is used across course design and delivery. The job is to make the AI work practical and keep it ethical, secure and academically honest.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate: STEM Education and AI Literacy
jobs.scope_summary: Research role in UGA's AI in STEM Education center, studying how AI literacy is taught in STEM classrooms.

jobs.title: Technology Integration Specialist (Tech Services)
jobs.scope_summary: Designs and leads teacher training on using technology and AI tools in instruction, then coaches staff on responsible AI use and data privacy through co-teaching and modeled lessons.

jobs.title: NASA-STEM Grant Program Coordinator, Curriculum and Instruction
jobs.scope_summary: Runs a one-year STEM and AI Literacy grant across several campuses, managing the budget, resources and rollout so the grant's AI literacy goals are met.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Applied AI
jobs.scope_summary: Defines and ships applied AI features for learners and enterprise customers on the combined Coursera and Udemy learning platform.

jobs.title: Senior Programs Lead, South
jobs.scope_summary: Builds and supports partnerships with school districts and education agencies across Southern states, especially Texas and Florida, to bring AI literacy programs to students.

jobs.title: AI Fluency and Computing Librarian
jobs.scope_summary: Prepares the university libraries to support Mason's growing AI and computing programs through instruction, research consultations, collections and outreach to engineering and science faculty and students.

jobs.title: Head of Trust & Safety
jobs.scope_summary: Owns the safety of the platform's AI output for teachers and students, covering guardrails, evaluations, red-teaming and incident response, plus safety documentation and RFP responses for districts.

jobs.title: Applied STEM & AI Specialist in Residence
jobs.scope_summary: Leads AI integration across the college through faculty training, responsible-use practices and a faculty community of practice, and helps launch a new applied STEM program, in a two-year grant-funded role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.scope_summary: Shapes the product for a nonprofit, open-source platform where educators and students build their own AI apps, adding new capabilities such as components and agents.

jobs.title: Digital Learning & Technology Specialist (PK-12)
jobs.scope_summary: Coaches PK-12 teachers on AI literacy and digital tools, runs staff training on generative AI for lesson design and prompting, and helps write the district's guidelines on academic integrity and AI data privacy.

jobs.title: Director of Curriculum Design & AI Integration
jobs.scope_summary: Reports to the AI Institute and sets university-wide curriculum design standards, including AI literacy competencies and AI integration guidelines, while helping faculty turn their course ideas into AI-enabled courses.

jobs.title: Instructional Technology Specialist
jobs.scope_summary: Trains staff to use generative AI responsibly in teaching, including evaluating AI output and protecting student data, and builds AI literacy and academic integrity practices for students across the school.

jobs.title: Professional Learning Facilitator (Contract)
jobs.scope_summary: Runs live virtual and in-person professional learning that helps schools and districts bring AI tools into instruction, as a flexible contract role for experienced educators.

jobs.title: Learning Solution Architect - AI/Software Engineering
jobs.scope_summary: Runs live training sessions, online and onsite, teaching staff at client companies how to build with AI and machine learning. Also writes the custom courses, projects, and assessments each client needs.

jobs.title: Applied AI Systems Tenure-line Faculty
jobs.scope_summary: Teaches AI courses in the Department of Human-Centered Computing and Social Informatics and runs an applied AI research program. This is a multi-hire search with appointments starting August 2027.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, AI Builder (all genders)
jobs.scope_summary: Leads design on Babbel's AI-first learning product, running discovery and making the main design calls. Builds working prototypes to test how learners talk to the AI and read its feedback.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar, Artificial Intelligence and Sustainability Education
jobs.scope_summary: Reviews the research on AI and sustainability, then turns it into teaching modules and classroom materials for undergraduate and graduate courses. Works with faculty to get those materials into real courses on a one year appointment.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer - AI Content Systems (all genders)
jobs.scope_summary: Sets the technical direction for the AI systems that produce Babbel's language lessons, and stays hands on with architecture and prototypes. Works across teams to agree shared standards and keep the systems reliable.

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Content Generation
jobs.scope_summary: Owns the system that generates and picks lesson content for Speak's AI language tutor, including what a learner practices next. Builds the review and quality checks that keep AI-written lessons good enough to ship.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (GenAI & Agentic Platforms)
jobs.scope_summary: Leads two engineering teams, about 8 to 12 people, who build the shared AI tools every other Preply team uses. That covers model access, evaluation, monitoring, and the guardrails around agents.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Platform/Ops Engineer
jobs.scope_summary: Gets machine learning models into production and keeps them running, from training pipelines through deployment and monitoring. Works between the machine learning, data, and infrastructure teams so model work is repeatable.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.scope_summary: Builds the AI features inside Teachstone's classroom observation tools and takes them from prototype to production. Also sets the evaluation and safety practices other engineers follow when they add AI to the product.

jobs.title: Program Manager for Cornell AI Initiatives
jobs.scope_summary: Keeps Cornell's university-wide AI initiative running, handling schedules, budgets, and the paperwork behind internal funding competitions, research programs, and events. Applications close October 17.

jobs.title: Manager, Master Data Management & Data/AI
jobs.scope_summary: Builds the district's master data and AI/ML strategy, leading a team that develops and deploys analytics and machine learning models to improve educational outcomes.

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Research
jobs.scope_summary: Leads a research team that tests whether the company's AI features for K-12 students are reliable, valid, and fair, and uses the findings to shape product and policy decisions.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Applied AI Research
jobs.scope_summary: Designs and runs applied AI and psychometric studies on the reliability, validity, and fairness of AI features in Edmentum's learning products.

jobs.title: Director, AI Strategy & Digital Success
jobs.scope_summary: Builds AI-driven customer success programs for a K-12 software company, including automated onboarding playbooks, a generative AI content engine, and AI models that predict which customers may leave.
